title: Surreal Cosmic Encounter
description: A vibrant surreal scene features a large smiling blue spherical spaceship with a broken shell revealing a starry night landscape inside, floating above a barren mountain landscape with a black hole below. To the left is a green furry monster holding a painter's palette, while to the right stands an elegant woman in a large white feathered hat.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a large cracked blue spherical spaceship with a smiling face and mechanical details, its broken shell revealing a starry night forest inside. A green furry one-eyed monster holding an artist's palette floats on the left, while an elegant beautiful woman in a large white feathered hat and white dress poses on the right. Swirling green and yellow nebulae surround them above a barren brown mountain range with a black hole at the center, in a vibrant whimsical cosmic style.
